high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Cindy Crawford. The post was made 10 hours prior to the screenshot being taken at 5:43 PM, as indicated by the timestamp in the top left corner. The post shows Cindy Crawford standing in front of a wall covered in graffiti. She is wearing a black long-sleeved shirt with white stripes on the sleeves, blue jeans, and sneakers. Her hair is long and brown, and she has her back turned to the camera. The wall behind her is densely covered with various graffiti tags, drawings, and messages. Some of the visible text includes "LESBIAN
